item.title: CedarLogic 0.3.1 (build 754)
item.description:
CedarLogic 0.3.1 for Mac

  • A new disk image: CedarLogic and Applications side by side, with the arrow between them.
  • The very first time CedarLogic opens, it plays a short sound of its own while the launch screen fills, then fades into the welcome.
  • Credits in About CedarLogic: CedarLogic began at Cedarville University and was modernized and brought to the Mac by Kieran Klukas; this version was rebuilt and extended with Claude.

Everything new in 0.3 (Your Circuits, templates, My Parts, Karnaugh maps and more) is in Help › What's New in CedarLogic.

item.title: CedarLogic 0.3 (build 751)
item.description:
CedarLogic 0.3 for Mac

A new name (just CedarLogic), a new icon, and a lot more inside. After you update, a short What's New tour walks you through all of it (Help ▸ What's New in CedarLogic brings it back).

Your circuits, in one place

  • Every circuit lives in Your Circuits (⌘O) and saves itself as you go. Open, rename and delete from there, or rename the one you're in from its name at the top.
  • Opening a .cdl file brings in a copy to work on; File ▸ Export as CedarLogic File… gets one out.
  • Version history only keeps a version when the circuit itself changed, not every time a switch flips.

Start ahead

  • File ▸ New from Template…: a Lab Page with your name on it, a 4-bit counter, a 7-segment decoder starter, or your own (Save as Template…). Settings ▸ General can start every new circuit from one.
  • My Parts: select some gates, Edit ▸ Save as Part…, name it. Drag it from the side panel or find it with A.

Check your work

  • The truth table (T) has tabs: the table, a Karnaugh map for each light, and the simplest sum of products and product of sums.
  • Edit ▸ Build from Formula… turns F = AB + C' (or Σm(…)) into wired, labelled gates.
  • Find (⌘F) searches labels, TO/FROM names and parts on every page.

See it think

  • Point at a wire and every branch of it lights up (Settings ▸ Canvas can show what it carries).
  • Share the oscilloscope (⌘G) as a timing diagram: copy, PNG or PDF, in colour or black and white.

A new look

  • CedarLogic green, the icon's colour, is the app's colour now (Settings ▸ Appearance ▸ App colour has the others).
  • A new welcome and guided tour, and cleaner editors for gate settings and memory (double-click a gate or a RAM; Return is Done).
  • ⌘Q asks first (Settings ▸ General ▸ Quitting), and Send Feedback (the speech bubble) takes a note, a screenshot or a short recording.

Fixes

  • The first ⌘A, ⌘N or ⌘Q after launch works; the Edit menu no longer flickers.
  • Dropping certain pasted circuits no longer crashes.
  • Your Circuits' Delete and Rename work every time, and the highlight stays on the circuit you chose.
  • Circuit windows open on the screen you launched from.
